newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ex-president Salinas plans return to Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Ex-president Salinas plans return to Mexico.

text.p: Mexico's former president Carlos Salinas De Gortari has said he plans to return to Mexico soon from self-imposed exile in Ireland.
"Shortly I will be in Mexico," Salinas said in a interview with Processo magazine, published on Sunday. "I don't want nor have any other destination."
Salinas left the president's office in December 1994 at the peak of his popularity, but an economic crisis and the arrest of his brother on various criminal charges helped tarnish his image.
The ex-president became a lightening rod for much of the discontent over the recession and political uncertainty that has bothered Mexico recently.
